expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: In the '3 free deliveries for you' promo banner, the white heading and the 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' subtext sit on a very light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast that makes the text hard to read.

The 'Order now' button inside the promo banner uses green text on a white pill, which is fine, but the banner's low-contrast text makes the call-to-code information (TALLINN3) easy to miss, reducing the promo's effectiveness.
